title: Ivo and the Compass
author: August Blackwood
blurb: Theo Zhou, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
